snapshot.inputs: All tracked implementation source, prompts, templates and schemas; package and lockfiles; main/renderer/library/test/lint/format configuration; packaged README and SDK metadata; coverage and archive plans; imported contracts and exact dependencies; all installed dependency bytes including compiler/native tools; verification harnesses and Node executable. Build override variables and renderer .env inputs were absent.

testCoordinationInput.role: Uncommitted coordination manifest read only to validate task IDs; excluded from production source cleanliness claim

snapshot.exclusions: Existing planning amendments, checklist/coordination receipts, SlopTimize state and graph output are not application/build inputs. program.json is explicitly hashed as an uncommitted test coordination input. The full checkout and full test input set are not claimed committed. No private sibling implementation is loaded.

builds.scope: Runtime library, Electron main/shared/preload and renderer compiled locally. Desktop archive contains compiled inputs with external Electron/Node/native dependencies, not an installable native app. No GUI session was qualified.

archiveValidation.scope: SHA-256/SHA-512, sidecars, manifests, member sets, safe paths and every payload hash verified before extraction. Every import of the desktop egress chokepoint (utils/fetchWithTimeout) and listener gate (enterprise/listener-gate), from tests and from the source sinks that hold through them (egress policy, tunnel manager, tailnet relay, permission relay, coworking bridge, maestro-p steering spawn), was redirected to the compiled desktop archive, and every import of the shared group chat spawn plan to the public runtime bundle; the egress, listener and background-turn cases ran on those bytes. Suites whose subject module itself depends on vi.mock replacements (local-effects ceiling, group chat participant spawn) were tried against the compiled bytes and failed only because the compiled module loads its own unmocked siblings; they stay source-only and are not claimed archive-tested. Public declaration checks (including a null steering socket answer) and plain Node load passed. Temporary identity-only pin leaves the historical runtime pin unchanged.

tests.boundary: Local typed-port and public-schema fixtures, real ceiling sources over temporary directories and recording sinks only. No signed production delivery, real tenant, provider, native peer or live endpoint supplied authority.

behavior: Under an installed egress authority fetchWithTimeout follows redirects itself and holds every resolved hop before it is requested; a refused hop is never fetched.

Listener ceilings are asked before bind at every desktop listener sink: the tunnel on every supervised respawn, the permission relay and coworking sockets, the Lite tailnet/LAN relay (ssh-tunnel kind) and the maestro-p and group chat steering sockets (a hold opens no steering channel and the turn runs unsteerable).

Local worktree checkout and remove run through the repository-ceiling git executor; a refused remove never reaches the filesystem. Writes that replace an existing path (copy overwrite, rename, remote download, Auto Run backup/restore/working copy, playbook ZIP import) are held once before the first mutation, and a confirmed local effect is re-held against the ceiling current at the answer.
The updater holds relaunch-on-quit and its feed source, refuses non-release target tags, and the managed status pane draws held and restart-needed roll-forward states without offering a held version.

CLI SSH remote create, update and remove write lockable settings through the desktop host (file only when standalone; an enrolled offline host refuses), and a refused list write never writes the default.

contractMappings.remaining: Residual effect holds consume the existing local ceiling sources (egress, listener, repository, local effects, update, settings). Explicit egress/listener/custody constraints in authenticated policy remain pending in the existing extension proposals; contract-coverage.json needed no new entry. No shipped wire operation or advertised capability was invented; production admission still requires authenticated negotiated authority.
